newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian stocks rise in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian stocks rise in quiet trade.

text.p: Lithuaninan stocks rose slightly in light trade on Monday, the Lithuanian National Stock Exchange said.
Overall central market volume was only 169,661 litas while the group A index, which follows the central market's 35 most active listings, grew by 36.17 points to 1588.55.
Birzai Milk Dairy continued to be actively traded turning over 94,944 litas but stayed unchanged at eight litas.
"After a successful issue of global depository receipts earlier this year, it is unlikely that Birzai shares would fall below eight litas," a Suprema dealer said.
Lithuanian Gas saw its shares rise to 1.2 litas from 1.15 in trade worth 20,619.
Ukio bank fell to 18.5 litas aginst 18.95 on turnover of 38,258 litas.
Block trades worth 32,959 litas were also made on Friday while volume on the secondary government Treasury bill market was only 7,899 litas.
